name: Wisp
conversations: My kite is called Sir Flappington. He's very brave. He's just... resting.
He's been resting a long time.
Tuck says if you run really, really fast, you make your own wind.
I tried. I made a stitch in my side. Sir Flappington didn't even wiggle.
Grown-ups used to laugh at the Kite Festival. Now they just say "maybe next year".
What's the festival even for? Nobody remembers. I asked.
